notes.title: New DLC "Rafter Five" now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42558613/3a5f8a1f5592652261d60567158a808f3513e2c2.png[/img]

New DLC "Rafter Five" now available!
In addition, the game is currently on sale for 25% off until 23:59 on Wednesday, December 13 (JST).
This is a great chance to pick up the game to play at home or while traveling at the end of the year.

[h2]Rafter Five[/h2]
5 rafters are collecting planks of wood to make their raft bigger. Try your best to instruct them to load the cargo into the raft. But be careful, the balance of the raft extensions is very important!
If a person that is supporting the raft is moved, the raft will collapse all at once.
Will you be able to skillfully build the raft and make it difficult for others to expand while also making sure you aren't the one to let it all fall apart?
Will it collapse!? Will it hold!? Enjoy the strange balancing act in this brainy, balance game!

Supported Players: Offline 1-8 Players, Online 1-8 Players (Playable with CPU opponents)

---

For more information on the update, please visit [url=https://oinkgames.com/en/news/3JbTmDZ5YumQOzDGUWtA74/]the official website[/url].

notes.title: New DLC "Kobayakawa" now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42558613/cce29e9934a66b361468239b15399d5aca962bb5.png[/img]

New DLC "Kobayakawa" now available!

[h2]Kobayakawa[/h2]
Kobayakawa is a simple, casino-style gambling card game.
After you play your turn, bet your coins and try to predict whether or not the last card in your hand has the biggest number among all of the players.
However, watch out for the tricky "Kobayakawa" card. This card is added to the lowest card's value, so even if you're holding the biggest number, a win is not guaranteed. Full of bluffing and bravery, this is a game exploding with excitement.

Supported Players: Offline 1 Player, Online 1-8 Players (Playable with CPU opponents)

---

For more information on the update, please visit [url=https://oinkgames.com/en/news/2ztA2QBGqN2CVM3bFjDcco/]the official website[/url].

notes.title: New DLC "Make the Difference" now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42558613/19695ea387d6b81abb1765d05cfaca7d19d4fdbc.png[/img]

New DLC "Make the Difference" now available!

[h2]Make the Difference[/h2]
Hey, newbie! Welcome! The main role of the DDD, "The Department of Difference Development", is making Spot the Difference puzzles!
We want YOU to take some of our premade illustrations and draw in some differences.
But hold on! We don't need to tell you that making it too easy isn't fun, but on the other hand, making it too hard can be a bummer too. You gotta find that sweet spot and make it just difficult enough to spot the differences.
If you spot the differences within the time limit, you score! For everyone that has ever wanted to make their own Spot the Difference puzzle, this is the board game for you!
There's even a solo create and capture mode too!

Supported Players: Offline 2-8 Players, Online 2-8 Players

---

For more information on the update, please visit [url=https://oinkgames.com/en/news/4a8TKLk0BnpubU0FY3EvFh/]the official website[/url].

notes.title: New DLC "NINE TILES" now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42558613/133053554bdb175041f63282ffd5a529f80078f2.png[/img]

New DLC "NINE TILES" now available!

[h2]NINE TILES[/h2]
The only thing you have to do is to move or flip the nine tiles in front of you with the goal to solve the puzzle faster than the other players.
The rules are very easy, but if you don't think about both sides of the tiles you won't be able to win easily.
"Nine Tiles" is a party puzzle game that is fun for children and adults! Be quick to win!

Supported Players: Offline 1-4 Players, Online 1-8 Players (Playable with CPU opponents)
When playing offline multiplayer, each player needs their own controller.

[h2]Update[/h2]
With this update, if one person purchases any of the paid DLC games, friends who already own "Let's Play! Oink Games" will be able to play the DLC together without everyone needing a copy! The iOS/Android versions are free to download, so if one of you purchases the game, all you and your friends can play together for free. Furthermore, if one of your friends purchases the Switch/Steam version, anyone can join in any of the seven games included already in the software, for free!

For more information on the update, please visit the official website.
